Footer.tagline: A stay in cabins surrounded by nature — peace, home cooking and mountain quiet.

Home.heroDescription: Stay in cabins surrounded by forest, enjoy home-cooked meals and return to nature, far from the city rush.
Home.welcomeDescription: Etno Village Raonica is a place where traditional A-frame cabin architecture meets the comfort of a modern stay. Every cabin is surrounded by forest and built to bring you back to nature — no rush, no noise, just peace.
Home.featureNatureDescription: The village sits at the foot of the mountain, surrounded by forest, meadows and clean air.
Home.featureFoodDescription: Dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms, following traditional recipes.
Home.featureTraditionDescription: The cabins are hand-built, in the spirit of this region's folk architecture.
Home.featurePeaceDescription: No city noise — just the sound of the forest and wind through the treetops.
Home.cabinsDescription: Four A-frame cabins, each with its own character — from intimate hideaways for two to spacious family cabins.
Home.galleryTitle: A look at the village and surroundings
Home.ctaDescription: Send a booking request and our team will contact you as soon as possible to confirm availability and the details of your stay.

About.title: The story of Etno Village Raonica
About.description: Etno Village Raonica was born from a wish to preserve the spirit of traditional building and hospitality of this region, and to offer guests a true break from everyday life.
About.paragraph1: The village sits at the foot of the mountain, surrounded by forest and clean air, far from city noise. Every cabin is hand-built from local wood, inspired by the region's traditional architecture, but with all the comfort today's guest expects.
About.paragraph2: We work to make every stay an authentic experience — from home-cooked food made with old recipes, to the peace that fills the village all year round. Whether you're after a family holiday, a romantic getaway for two, or simply the quiet of nature, Raonica is waiting for you.
